arxiv-2106-12301.title: Functional analytic methods for discrete approximations of subwavelength resonator systems
arxiv-2106-12301.creator: Habib Ammari, Bryn Davies, Erik Orvehed Hiltunen
arxiv-2106-12301.description: Abstract We survey functional analytic methods for studying subwavelength resonator systems. In particular, rigorous discrete approximations of Helmholtz scattering problems are derived in an asymptotic subwavelength regime. This is achieved by re-framing the Helmholtz equation as a non-linear eigenvalue problem in terms of integral operators.

arxiv-2205-08027.title: Energy transfer in quantum molecular chain – two models of inhomogeneity
arxiv-2205-08027.creator: B. A. Tay
arxiv-2205-08027.description: Abstract We study a linear chain of oscillators with inhomogeneity in their interactions with phonon bath. In a previous work on the Markovian master equation of the system, we investigated a model in which the difference in the site-phonon coupling between adjacent oscillators is the same throughout the chain.

arxiv-2210-08920.title: Preservation of the harmonic overtones in the violin family beyond Stradivari
arxiv-2210-08920.creator: Li Su, Chen-Chieh Chang, Yu-Ming Lin, Li-Chun Lu, Yi-Wen Liu, Ming-Sian Bai, Chyh-Hong Chern
arxiv-2210-08920.description: Abstract Three hundred years ago, Antonio Stradivari enjoyed the golden period of the violin making in the human history. Luthiers and researchers endeavor to study his legendary legacy. Unfortunately, a consensus that the present progress has reached his level remains lacking. Most of the instruments suffer from low sounding power and enigmatic deficit of harmonic overtones.

arxiv-2301-11561.title: Control Scheme for Polarization Circulation Speed Meter Using a Dual-Retardation Waveplate
arxiv-2301-11561.creator: Yohei Nishino 1,2, Tomotada Akutsu 2, Yoichi Aso 2,3, Takayuki Tomaru 1,2,3,4,5
arxiv-2301-11561.description: Abstract In interferometric gravitational wave detectors, quantum radiation pressure noise, which is a back action of the measurement, limits their sensitivity at low frequencies. Speed meters are one of the techniques to reduce the back action noise and improve the sensitivity. Furthermore, a speed meter detector can surpass the standard quantum limit over a wide range of frequencies.

arxiv-2404-04015.title: A Flexible Evolutionary Algorithm With Dynamic Mutation Rate Archive
arxiv-2404-04015.creator: Martin S. Krejca, Carsten Witt
arxiv-2404-04015.description: Abstract . We propose a new, flexible approach for dynamically maintaining successful mutation rates in evolutionary algorithms using k k -bit flip mutations. The algorithm adds successful mutation rates to an archive of promising rates that are favored in subsequent steps.

arxiv-2406-20020.title: A fast-filament eruption observed in the H α \alpha spectral line
arxiv-2406-20020.creator: Denis P. Cabezas ,, Kiyoshi Ichimoto, Ayumi Asai, Satoru UeNo, Satoshi Morita, Ken-ichi Otsuji, Kazunari Shibata
arxiv-2406-20020.description: Abstract Context. Solar filament eruptions usually appear to occur in association with the sudden explosive release of magnetic energy accumulated in long-lived arched magnetic structures. It is the released energy that occasionally drives fast-filament eruptions that can be source regions of coronal mass ejections.

arxiv-2501-17958.title: The origin of vorticity in viscous incompressible flows
arxiv-2501-17958.creator: Tianrui Xiang 1, Gregory L. Eyink 1,2, Tamer A. Zaki 1,2
arxiv-2501-17958.description: Abstract In inviscid, incompressible flows, the evolution of vorticity is exactly equivalent to that of an infinitesimal material line-element, and hence vorticity can be traced forward or backward in time in a Lagrangian fashion. This elegant and powerful description is not possible in viscous flows due to the action of diffusion.

arxiv-2503-04642.title: Surface Code Error Correction with Crosstalk Noise
arxiv-2503-04642.creator: Zeyuan Zhou, Andrew Ji, Yongshan Ding
arxiv-2503-04642.description: Abstract The design and performance analysis of quantum error correction (QEC) codes are often based on incoherent and independent noise models since it is easy to simulate. However, these models fail to capture realistic hardware noise sources, such as correlated errors (crosstalk), which can significantly impact QEC code performance, especially when they occur between data and ancillary qubits.

arxiv-2506-10242.title: DySS: Dynamic Queries and State-Space Learning for Efficient 3D Object Detection from Multi-Camera Videos Thanks: Qualcomm AI Research is an initiative of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc
arxiv-2506-10242.creator: Rajeev Yasarla Shizhong Han Hong Cai Fatih Porikli
arxiv-2506-10242.description: Abstract Camera-based 3D object detection in Bird’s Eye View (BEV) is one of the most important perception tasks in autonomous driving. Earlier methods rely on dense BEV features, which are costly to construct. More recent works explore sparse query-based detection.

brown-dissertation-poetry-music-1763.creator: John Brown
brown-dissertation-poetry-music-1763.description: Brown's 1763 Dissertation on Poetry and Music - early comparative aesthetics.

jewish-encyclopedia-1906-mordecai-mokiah.creator: Gotthard Deutsch

pmc-10566337.title: A rare case of bilateral distal segmental absence of fallopian tubes in a patient presenting with hydrosalpinx
pmc-10566337.creator: Karolina Wiśniewska, Michał Wojciechowski
pmc-10566337.description: Isolated fallopian tube anomalies are a rare group of disorders, usually observed in otherwise asymptomatic patients. If symptomatic, the patients may present with infertility or unspecified abdominal pains. Various aetiologies have been proposed to explain this phenomenon, ranging from congenital to vascular events.

pmc-10986212.title: Disparities in property insurance relief among socially vulnerable Texas communities after Winter Storm Uri
pmc-10986212.creator: Aaron Hedquist, Renee N Salas, Mark Soto, Endel John Orav, Jose F Figueroa
pmc-10986212.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Property insurance is an important tool for resiliency from the accelerating impacts of climate-intensified extreme weather events. However, disparities in property insurance payouts may reduce their potential protective effects. The objective of this study was to quantify disparities in insurance payouts by Texas’ insurers after the 2021 Winter Storm Uri, and to understand if any socioeconomic factors were associated with higher rates of declined relief.

pmc-11420669.title: eQTL-Detect: nextflow-based pipeline for eQTL detection in modular format with sharable and parallelizable scripts
pmc-11420669.creator: Praveen Krishna Chitneedi, Frieder Hadlich, Gabriel C M Moreira, Jose Espinosa-Carrasco, Changxi Li, Graham Plastow, Daniel Fischer, Carole Charlier, Dominique Rocha, Amanda J Chamberlain, Christa Kuehn
pmc-11420669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Bioinformatic pipelines are becoming increasingly complex with the ever-accumulating amount of Next-generation sequencing (NGS) data. Their orchestration is difficult with a simple Bash script, but bioinformatics workflow managers such as Nextflow provide a framework to overcome respective problems.

pmc-11653980.title: Students’ experiences of placements in urban Indigenous health contexts: developing a culturally responsive workforce
pmc-11653980.creator: Kate Odgers-Jewell, Alison Nelson, Renee Brown, Nicole Hunter, Tiffany Atkins, Kelly Menzel
pmc-11653980.description: BackgroundA culturally responsive health workforce is essential to ensure the delivery of culturally safe health services that meet Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples needs. In partnership with universities, placement providers play an essential role in creating opportunities for immersive experiences that enable students to develop their cultural responsiveness.

pmc-12684969.title: Quick Analysis of Sedimentary Ancient DNA Using quicksand
pmc-12684969.creator: Merlin Szymanski, Johann Visagie, Frédéric Romagné, Matthias Meyer, Janet Kelso
pmc-12684969.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Ancient DNA extracted from the sediments of archaeological sites (sedaDNA) can provide fine-grained information about the composition of past ecosystems and human site use, even in the absence of visible remains. However, the growing amount of available sequencing data and the nature of the data obtained from archaeological sediments pose several computational challenges; among these, the rapid and accurate taxonomic classification of sequences.

pmc-12685500.title: Trends in smoking prevalence before and after the emergence of vaping in Aotearoa/New Zealand among 14–15-year-olds identifying as Māori, Pacific, European, or Asian: an interrupted time series analysis of repeated cross-sectional data, 2003–2024
pmc-12685500.creator: Sam Egger, Andrew Waa, Michael David, Judith McCool, Lucy Hardie, Marianne F. Weber, Qingwei Luo, Jamie Egger, Becky Freeman
pmc-12685500.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). SummaryBackgroundEthnic inequities in health and mortality in Aotearoa/New Zealand have been driven in part by historic and ongoing inequities in smoking prevalence, with Māori and Pacific peoples most affected. Although overall smoking rates among year 10 students aged 14–15 years have declined substantially in recent decades, recent analyses suggested that e-cigarette use (vaping) may have slowed the decline in ever- and regular-smoking, while having little or no impact on daily smoking.

pmc-12771878.title: Fluid balance and mortality in adult ICU patients with sepsis or septic shock: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
pmc-12771878.creator: Federico Fonda, Daniele Orso, Irene Comisso, Eleonora De Crignis, Francesco Meroi, Bino Galioto, Tiziana Bove, Giorgio Della Rocca
pmc-12771878.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundFluid therapy is a cornerstone of sepsis management; however, excessive fluid accumulation might be associated with adverse outcomes. The association between fluid balance (FB) and mortality in critically ill patients with sepsis or septic shock remains uncertain.MethodsWe conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies assessing the association between FB and mortality in adult ICU patients with sepsis or septic shock (PubMed, Scopus, CINAHL; through May 2024).

pmc-12929323.title: Evaluation of the effects of a gel containing green tea and hyaluronic acid on clinical and Microbiological outcomes following periodontal surgery. A randomized, controlled, double-blinded, noninferiority trial
pmc-12929323.creator: Laura Sanches Gonçalves, Stéffany Souza Melo, Guilherme José Pimentel Lopes de Oliveira, Luciene Cristina Figueiredo, Fabio José Barbosa Bezerra, Flávia Aparecida Chaves Furlaneto, Sérgio Luís Scombatti de Souza
pmc-12929323.description: ObjectivesTo evaluate the clinical and microbiological effects of a gel containing green tea and hyaluronic acid (GT/HA) following open-flap debridement surgery in comparison with those of a chlorhexidine-based gel.Materials and methodsThis randomized, controlled, double-blind, noninferiority trial included 38 patients with stage 3 periodontitis.

pmc-13211889.title: Dermoscopy and LC-OCT in the Evaluation and Management of Solitary Trichoepithelioma: A Diagnostic–Therapeutic Flowchart
pmc-13211889.creator: Antonio Di Guardo, Luca Guarino, Maria Elisabetta Greco, Umberto Gallo, Steven P Nisticò, Giovanni Pellacani, Carmen Cantisani
pmc-13211889.description: n may lead to the development of multiple lesions, as observed in Brooke-Spiegler syndrome. Importantly, TE presents a significant challenge in differential diagnosis compared to basal cell carcinoma (BCC), both clinically and dermoscopically [2]. Beyond dermoscopy, other non-invasive diagnostic techniques, such as reflectance confocal microscopy (RCM) and line-field optical coherence tomography (LC-OCT), can also support preoperative diagnosis.

pmc-13292053.title: BCL2-Associated Transcription Factor 1 Promotes SRC/Hypoxia-Inducible Factor 1 Subunit α-Mediated Cancer Stemness in Radioresistant Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
pmc-13292053.creator: Yu-Hao Huang, Hao-Yeh Chen, Peng-Ju Chien, Chun-Yu Chen, Shao-Ti Li, Hsueh-Te Lee, Yueh-Chun Lee, Wen-Wei Chang

pmc-13315305.title: The effects of menopausal hormone therapy on cardiovascular disease, cancer, cognition and depression in younger women: A systematic review
pmc-13315305.creator: Patricia A Bencivenga, Natalie Fort, Adriane Fugh-Berman, Anthony R Scialli
pmc-13315305.description: ObjectiveThe Women's Health Initiative (WHI), a randomized controlled trial, found no overall health benefit of menopausal hormone therapy. Our objective was to evaluate the hypothesis that initiating hormonal therapy prior to age 60 or within a few years after the last menstrual period provides health benefits in menopausal women.DesignA search was conducted in MEDLINE, Scopus, and ClinicalTrials.

pmc-13324536.title: CoQ10 oxidoreductases in ferroptosis and cancer: redox regulation and therapeutic opportunities
pmc-13324536.creator: Jumi Lee, Inhwan Yoo, Minseok Kim, Hyeonseok Kim, Namgyu Lee
pmc-13324536.description: Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10) is a highly conserved lipophilic redox cofactor that mediates electron transport in mitochondria and protects cells against oxidative stress. Increasing evidence has revealed that CoQ10 and its associated oxidoreductases serve as critical regulators of ferroptosis—an iron-dependent, lipid peroxidation-driven form of cell death.

pmc-13354579.title: The EF-hand domain of MINDY3 is a ubiquitin and RAD23 UBL-binding domain
pmc-13354579.creator: Lee A Armstrong, Matthew R McFarland, Rachel O’Dea, Roscislaw Krutyholowa, Magdalena Gorka, Thomas Carroll, Sebastian Glatt, Yogesh Kulathu
pmc-13354579.description: The MINDY family of deubiquitinases (DUBs) are exemplified by their preference for cleaving K48-linked polyubiquitin. MINDY3 is architecturally distinct from other MINDY DUBs as its catalytic domain spans the entire length of the protein except for an atypical EF-hand insertion.

pmc-13464168.title: The defining characteristics of pasture-based systems in temperate regions
pmc-13464168.creator: B Horan, S Stirling, R Bryant, L Delaby
pmc-13464168.description: Pasture is an important source of feed for dairy and beef cattle in many parts of the world, but its predominant use in some dairy production systems such as those traditional to Western Europe, South America, and Oceania is relatively unique, with only 10% to 15% of global dairy products derived from such systems.

pmc-13528523.title: A Fixed‐Charge Interphase Synchronizes Ion Transport to Suppress Space‐Charge‐Driven Inefficiency Under Nanoliter Confinement
pmc-13528523.creator: Yaping Yan, Jiachen Ma, Wenlan Zhang, Hongmei Tang, Yue Li, Ruhuai Mei, Yang Huang, Daniil Karnaushenko, Dmitriy D. Karnaushenko, Yumin Luo, Kai Zhang, Oliver G. Schmidt, Minshen Zhu
pmc-13528523.description: Ion transport at electrified interfaces is conventionally described by the redistribution of mobile ions to preserve local electroneutrality. Under extreme electrolyte confinement, however, this assumption fails as the characteristic transport length approaches the Debye screening length, giving rise to space‐charge accumulation and slow electrostatic relaxation that dominate interfacial kinetics.
